description: Read contacts, inboxes, messages, templates, tags and tracked links in Heymarket.

heymarket_contact_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a contact changes in Heymarket. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields avatar, inbox_opt_outs, created, creator_id, custom, display_name, email, external_id, external_ref, first, id, inbox_id, last, note, op, parent_id, phone, rev, shared, team_id, type, updated, assigned_user_id, tags

heymarket_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact in Heymarket. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields avatar, inbox_opt_outs, created, creator_id, custom, display_name, email, external_id, external_ref, first, id, inbox_id, last, note, op, parent_id, phone, rev, shared, team_id, type, updated, assigned_user_id, tags

heymarket_new_link_trigger.description: Runs for each new link in Heymarket. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, short_code, short_url, original_url, team_id, target, conversation_id, broadcast_id, campaign_step_id, template_id, last_visited_at, created_at
